name: Archer Whimsy
author: archer (fork of rover)
description: A playful collection of desktop widgets for Omarchy: typographic clocks and date displays, analog/flip/cyber clocks, day progress, retro cassette and vinyl music players, audio visualizers, volume, hardware telemetry pills/rings, and weather styles — all placed as drag-to-desktop widgets.

barWidget.description: A playful widget suite — clocks, music players, visualizers, date displays, system telemetry, and weather
